title: german billionaire kuehne dies age 89 manager magazin reports 2026 08 24
text:
FRANKFURT, Aug 24 (Reuters) - German investor Klaus-Michael Kuehne, the ​controlling shareholder of Swiss logistics group Kuehne + ‌Nagel (KNIN.S)
, opens new tab
, has died aged 89, the company said on Monday.
Kuehne, the grandson of company co-founder August Kuehne, also ​held major stakes in German groups ​Lufthansa (LHAG.DE)
, opens new tab
, Hapag-Lloyd (HLAG.DE)
, opens new tab
 and chemicals trade group Brenntag (BNRGn.DE)
, opens new tab
 as ⁠well as bus and train services operator ​Flix.
A dominant figure in global shipping and logistics, ​he transformed Kuehne + Nagel from a family freight forwarder into one of the world's largest logistics groups and ​amassed a fortune that made him one of ​Germany's richest investors.
His holdings are worth more than $44.2 billion, according ‌to ⁠Forbes.
He became CEO of Kuehne and Nagel in 1975 and was the chairman of its board of directors between 1992 and 2011.
With strong ​family ties ​to northern ⁠Germany, Kuehne formed a group of investors that agreed to buy Hapag-Lloyd's ​Hamburg-based container shipping business from TUI ​in ⁠2008 to prevent it from getting folded into a global rival.
A commanding presence among German family ⁠investors, he ​later acquired 20% of ​the voting rights in German flagship carrier Lufthansa Group (LHAG.DE)
, opens new tab
.
